scope: 30 selected / 30 reused / 0 new; no question/answer/option/grader/progress writes
privacy_policy: Teaching IDs/conditions/token-option text plus opaque snapshot hashes only; no raw SQL row families, timestamps, secrets, runtime identity or progress.

review_summary.null_policy: Six new exact B1/B1/B1/B2/A2/A2 practice filters each select twelve existing thematic type-four rows. Continuing source ranges and SQL NULL teaching blocks are retained and do not select widget questions.
review_summary.boundary: Only thirty selected functions are accepted here. Every eligible row is snapshot-bound, but other rows are scope exclusions, not universally invalid.

clone_only_policy: The complete fourteen question attributes and loaded answer/option/pivot/hint snapshots must match. Only the Ukrainian condition may change on unsaved canonical-theory clones. No answer/token/option/formatter/casing/grader change.

formatter_review.settled_string_policy: Actual unchanged native methods replayed on ROOT and WT below. Original punctuation and repeated token instances retained; no strict case/punctuation grading claim.
